name: noise_mask / KSamplerX0Inpaint (masked denoising)
plain: How masked sampling works in core: at each step the region outside the mask is replaced by the original latent noised to the current sigma with the same noise tensor, and the output is composited with the original at the end of each call. So noise is confined in effect rather than masked at the start.
math:
mask m (1=denoise). x ← x·m + noise_scaling(σ, ε, z)·(1−m); out ← model(x,σ)·m + z·(1−m).
ε is the initial noise tensor kept for the whole run.
label: from code
surprise: Model class at model_base.py:1213 overrides scale_latent_inpaint to return the latent with no noise at all.
